Your Ground Partner in Morocco A Marrakech DMC Built for Repeat B2B Business Morocco Quest is a licensed DMC Marrakech partner providing luxury destination management and net-rate ground handling for travel agents, tour operators, incentive houses and MICE planners — from a 12-person board retreat in a private riad to a 400-delegate conference with a Sahara gala finale. We run ground programmes for agencies across Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia on a confidential, net-rate basis. No client-facing branding, no commission visible in your pricing — just a local team that delivers what's on the brief, on the ground, every time. From single private tours to full MICE Marrakech and events Marrakech production, we operate as your local desk: sourcing, contracting, logistics and on-site troubleshooting handled so you can stay focused on the client relationship. DMC Marrakech at a Glance Based inMarrakech, Morocco — with operations across the whole country LicenceMoroccan Ministry of Tourism licensed tour operator, fully insured Business modelTrade-only, white-label, confidential net rates Group range2 to 500+ participants Core marketsUK, Europe, North America, GCC, Asia LanguagesEN · FR · ES · AR (DE, IT, PT, RU, ZH, JA on request) Quote turnaroundWithin 24 hours / one business day SupportDedicated account manager + 24/7 operations line SpecialitiesMICE Marrakech, incentive travel, team building, luxury private tours, Sahara programmes Marrakech as a MICE Destination Few cities make a DMC's job easier. Marrakech combines short-haul access with long-haul exoticism — which is exactly why incentive houses and congress organisers keep returning. Access — Marrakech Menara Airport (RAK) has direct flights from 100+ European cities in under 4 hours, plus daily connections from the Gulf and North America via Casablanca. Venues — 5-star palace hotels, a 3,500-seat congress centre, exclusive-use riads, private estates in the Palmeraie and desert camps 45 minutes away. Hotel inventory — over 30,000 beds, from boutique riads to internationally branded conference resorts. Climate — 300+ days of sunshine; spring and autumn deliver 22–28 °C for outdoor programmes. Wow factor — the medina, Jemaa el-Fnaa, the Atlas skyline and two deserts within reach make every itinerary photogenic. Value — luxury delivery at rates that compare favourably with Southern Europe and the Gulf. Safety — a stable, welcoming destination with dedicated tourist police and a mature hospitality sector. A DMC Marrakech partner who knows this inventory intimately turns those advantages into a programme that runs on time and on budget. MICE & Incentive Travel Services MICE Marrakech is our core business. The city has the venues, the hotels, the airport and the wow factor — we add the local team that turns a concept into an operationally flawless event. Corporate Events & Conferences Venue sourcing & contracting — palaces, five-star conference hotels, private estates, desert camps Accommodation blocks across 3 to 5-star properties, negotiated on net rates Delegate management — arrivals, registration, hospitality desks, rooming lists AV, staging & production through our vetted technical partners Gala dinners & themed evenings — a 1,001-nights dinner in a Palmeraie palace, a lantern-lit banquet in Agafay On-site staffing — bilingual hostesses, coordinators, security liaison Example: a 3-day pharmaceutical congress for 260 delegates — plenary in a Hivernage hotel, 4 parallel workshops, welcome cocktail in a riad, closing gala under the stars in Agafay. Incentive Travel Programs Signature arrivals — rose-water welcome, private airport meet & greet, VIP fast-track where available Exclusive-use venues — buy-out riads, private palaces, desert camps reserved for your group only Wow moments — hot-air balloon at dawn, helicopter transfer to the Atlas, sunset camel caravan, private concert in a kasbah Layered itineraries — free time balanced with curated experiences so every delegate returns with a story Gifting & branding — bespoke Moroccan gifts, branded touchpoints, custom menus Example: a 45-person sales-award incentive — 4 nights across a Marrakech palace hotel and a luxury Agafay camp, cooking class, quad-bike sunset, private hammam evening, gala with Gnaoua musicians. Team Building & Wellness Retreats Outcome-driven formats — collaboration, leadership, culture, celebration Wellness retreats — yoga on riad rooftops, hammam rituals, Atlas Mountain hikes, mindful desert nights Hybrid days — morning workshop, afternoon medina challenge, evening rooftop dinner Full facilitation — English/French-speaking facilitators, scoring, prizes, photo & video coverage Example: a 30-person leadership retreat — 2 nights in a private Atlas kasbah, guided trek to a Berber village, tagine-cooking competition, strategy sessions with a mountain view. View Team Building & Incentive Travel options → Destination Services & Activities As a full-service destination management company, we operate every element of the ground programme — so you contract one partner, not ten suppliers. Guided City Tours & Cultural Immersion The Medina — souks, fondouks, artisan quarters, guided by licensed local experts Koutoubia Mosque & Gardens — the city's landmark minaret and the perfect starting point for a walking tour Bahia Palace — 19th-century grandeur, zellige, cedar ceilings and courtyard gardens Jemaa el-Fnaa — storytellers, musicians and food stalls at dusk, with reserved rooftop seating for groups Ben Youssef Madrasa, Saadian Tombs, Majorelle & Le Jardin Secret — combined into half-day or full-day circuits Immersive add-ons — calligraphy classes, spice-souk tastings, private meetings with master artisans Formats: 2-hour walking tours, half-day guided circuits, full-day cultural immersion, evening food walks. Desert Camps & Sahara Experiences Agafay Desert (45 minutes from Marrakech) — luxury tented camps with private dining, pools and lounges; ideal for gala dinners, one-night incentives and team building; quad biking, camel rides, stargazing, live music. Erg Chebbi & Merzouga (Sahara) — overnight stays in private luxury camps beneath the great dunes; camel caravan at sunset, 4x4 dune safaris, Gnaoua music by the fire. Reached via a 2-day Atlas & Kasbah route (Aït Ben Haddou, Dadès and Todra Gorges) or by domestic flight to Errachidia. Best for 3 to 6-night programmes and high-impact incentives. We manage every layer: camp buy-outs, convoy logistics, menus, welfare and contingency for remote locations. Accommodation & Transfer Coordination Long-standing riad partnerships in the medina — exclusive-use buy-outs for 8 to 40 guests Luxury hotels & palaces — Hivernage, Palmeraie, Agdal and the Atlas foothills Room blocks on negotiated net rates with clear release dates; site inspections and virtual walk-throughs on request Airport meet & greet at Marrakech Menara (RAK), Casablanca (CMN), Fes (FEZ), Agadir (AGA) Executive minivans, luxury coaches, 4x4 fleets and chauffeur-driven cars Inter-city logistics with timed departures, luggage handling and on-board hosts; staggered arrival management for large delegations Dining, Culinary & Wellness Experiences Private riad dinners with live oud or Gnaoua music; rooftop dining above the medina at sunset Chef-led cooking classes — tagine, couscous, pastilla, mint tea ceremony Palace gala banquets for 100–500 guests, with full production Street-food walks on Jemaa el-Fnaa; wine & olive-oil tastings in the Atlas foothills All dietary requirements handled: halal by default, vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, kosher-style on request Wellness & spa — traditional hammam rituals, private spa buy-outs, rooftop yoga, Atlas retreats 12 Team Building Activities in Marrakech Twelve proven formats, delivered with facilitators, transport, equipment and insurance included. Mix and match to your objectives and timing. Moroccan Cooking Class Challenge — teams source spices in the souk, then compete to cook the best tagine under a chef's guidance. Camel Trekking in the Sahara — a sunset caravan across the Erg Chebbi dunes to a private camp. Horseback Riding in the Palmeraie — guided rides through palm groves and Berber villages. Traditional Hammam Experience — a private spa buy-out with black-soap scrub, argan rituals and mint tea. Medina Treasure Hunt — GPS-guided teams decode clues across souks, fondouks and hidden squares. Pottery & Carpet-Weaving Workshops — hands-on sessions with master artisans. Sunset at Jemaa el-Fnaa — reserved rooftop terrace, street-food tasting menu and a guided walk. Quad Biking & Desert Adventures — guided quad or buggy circuits across Agafay, then lunch at a luxury camp. Atlas Mountains Hiking — guided treks from Imlil or the Ourika Valley, with lunch in a Berber family home. Souk Market Tour & Haggling Workshop — learn the etiquette, then compete to negotiate the best price. Tagine Preparation & Dining Experience — cook, dine and share stories in a private riad courtyard. Berber Village Homestay — an overnight immersion in the High Atlas; shared meals, storytelling and a dawn walk. Optional add-ons: hot-air balloon flights, olympic-style desert games, calligraphy classes, drum circles, CSR days with local associations. Beyond Marrakech: Nationwide Destination Management One DMC partner, the whole of Morocco. Marrakech is our base; the country is our product. Fes — the world's largest living medieval medina; tanneries, madrasas, gala dinners in restored palaces Casablanca — Morocco's business capital; corporate arrivals, Hassan II Mosque, conference hotels Rabat — the capital; government-level events, Kasbah of the Udayas, Hassan Tower, Chellah Tangier & Chefchaouen — Mediterranean gateway and the blue medina; ideal for Spain-combined programmes Essaouira — Atlantic breeze, UNESCO medina, seafood, wind sports and Gnaoua music; 2.5 hours from Marrakech Agadir & Taghazout — beach resorts, golf, surf and wellness for large leisure groups The Atlas Mountains — Imlil, Ourika, Ouirgane; kasbah hotels, treks, Berber hospitality Ouarzazate & the Kasbah Route — Aït Ben Haddou, film studios, Dadès and Todra gorges Erg Chebbi & Erg Chigaga — the great Saharan dunes; luxury camps, 4x4 safaris Signature multi-city routes: Imperial Cities (Marrakech · Fes · Meknes · Rabat), Sahara Circuit (Marrakech · Atlas · Merzouga · Fes), Coast & Medina (Marrakech · Essaouira · Agadir). Each route is delivered end-to-end by the same Morocco Quest team. Why Travel Agents & Tour Operators Partner With Us Beyond MICE, FIT and small-group bookings come to us year-round from agencies and operators who need a reliable Marrakech ground handler for their own product. Send B2B Enquiry We reply within 24 hours — or call us: +212 654 069 718 FAQ Frequently Asked Questions — DMC Marrakech What services does a DMC in Marrakech provide? A destination management company handles every on-the-ground element of a programme: venue and hotel sourcing, transfers, guides, activities, dining, event production, staffing and 24/7 support. Morocco Quest acts as your local operations desk, contracting suppliers on your behalf and delivering under your brand. How far in advance should we book a MICE programme? For groups of 20–60 we recommend 3–6 months; for conferences and incentives of 100+ delegates, 6–12 months to secure the best hotel blocks and exclusive-use venues, especially in peak season (March–May and October–December). Short-notice requests are welcome — we regularly deliver quality programmes on 4–6 weeks' notice. What is included in a MICE package? Typically: accommodation blocks, airport and inter-city transfers, meeting venues, AV and production, guided tours and activities, gala dinners, on-site coordinators and 24/7 support. Every package is line-itemised so you can include or exclude any element. Can you accommodate dietary restrictions? Yes. Moroccan cuisine is naturally halal and largely vegetarian-friendly. We routinely cater for vegan, gluten-free, lactose-free, nut-allergy and kosher-style requirements, and we brief every venue and chef in writing before arrival. What is the minimum group size? There is none. We operate private FIT travel for couples and families as well as groups of 500+. Group rates and exclusive-use venues typically become cost-effective from around 10 participants. Do you offer multi-city itineraries? Absolutely. Marrakech is the ideal base, but we design programmes across Fes, Casablanca, Rabat, Tangier, Chefchaouen, Essaouira, Agadir and the Sahara. Inter-city transfers, domestic flights and hotel changes are managed as one seamless programme. How do you ensure safety and security? We are a licensed Moroccan tour operator with full liability insurance. Each programme includes a risk assessment, vetted transport with licensed drivers, on-site bilingual staff, medical and emergency contacts, and contingency plans for weather or venue changes. Marrakech has a dedicated tourist police unit. What payment terms do you offer? Standard terms are a deposit on contract signature, a second instalment before arrival and balance on completion; exact percentages depend on programme size and supplier terms. We invoice in EUR, USD, GBP or MAD and accept bank transfer and major cards. Trade accounts with credit terms are available for established partners. Can you provide references from previous clients? Yes. On request, we share references from agencies, operators and corporate clients in your market, under NDA where required. What is your cancellation policy? We mirror the cancellation terms of our contracted suppliers and pass them through transparently in your quote, with clear release dates for hotel blocks. Where possible we negotiate flexible terms — particularly for early bookings — and we advise on travel insurance for the group. Do you offer virtual site visits or pre-trip consultations? Yes. We offer video consultations, virtual walk-throughs of hotels, riads and venues, and can host in-person site inspections for planners visiting Marrakech. Site-inspection costs are typically credited back on confirmed programmes. How do you handle logistics for large groups (100+ participants)? With planning and staffing. For large delegations we run multi-hotel room blocks, staggered airport arrivals, colour-coded transfer manifests, hospitality desks, parallel activity tracks and a dedicated operations team on site. We have delivered programmes for 400+ delegates in Marrakech. What languages do your guides speak? English, French, Spanish and Arabic as standard. German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese and Japanese-speaking guides are available on request. Are there seasonal considerations for Marrakech? Spring (March–May) and autumn (October–December) offer ideal temperatures for outdoor programmes. Summer (July–August) is hot — we schedule activities early and late and lean on pools, riads and the cooler Atlas. Winter is mild and excellent value, with Sahara nights cold but spectacular. Ramadan dates shift each year and affect some venues' dining hours — we plan around them. How do you customise experiences for different industries or interests? Every programme starts with your brief: objectives, audience profile, budget and must-haves. From there we adapt content — CSR and community projects for purpose-led companies, design and craft tours for creative industries, wellness retreats for healthcare and tech teams, high-adrenaline formats for sales incentives. Nothing is off the shelf.
